dashboard.label: P7 — Phishing Email Investigation & Security Operations
dashboard.description: Operational SOC Dashboard: Real-time email gateway telemetry, Postfix MTA transaction analysis, suspicious sender detection, malicious attachment triage, and credential harvester URL extraction.

search.query: index=email sourcetype="postfix:syslog" | rex "postfix/\w+\[\d+\]: (?[A-F0-9]{8,12}):" | stats dc(queue_id) as count

index=email sourcetype="postfix:syslog" | rex "postfix/\w+\[\d+\]: (?[A-F0-9]{8,12}):" | rex "header Subject: (?.*?) from \w+\[" | rex "header From: (?.*?) from \w+\[" | rex "(?:body|header)[^:\n]*:.*?(?https?://[^\s>\"\'\)]+)" | rex "(?<attachment_name>[\w\.\-]+\.(?:exe|xlsm|iso|pdf|vbs))" | stats values(sender) as sender, values(subject) as subject, values(attachment_name) as attachment_name, values(url) as url by queue_id | where isnotnull(sender) | eval is_threat=if(match(subject, "(?i)(urgent|wire transfer|action required|password|overdue|deposit)") OR match(sender, "(?i)(gmail\.com|spoofed|micros0ft|quick-invoices|docusign|hr-internal)") OR match(attachment_name, "(?i)\.(exe|xlsm|iso|vbs)") OR match(url, "(?i)(login|portal|auth|update|194\.)"), 1, 0) | where is_threat=1 | stats count

index=email sourcetype="postfix:syslog" | rex "(?<attachment_name>[\w\.\-]+\.(?:exe|xlsm|iso|pdf|vbs))" | where isnotnull(attachment_name) AND match(attachment_name, "(?i)\.(exe|xlsm|iso|vbs)") | stats count

index=email sourcetype="postfix:syslog" | rex "(?:body|header)[^:\n]*:.*?(?<url>https?://[^\s>\"\'\)]+)" | where isnotnull(url) AND match(url, "(?i)(login|portal|auth|update|194\.|\.php)") | stats dc(url) as count

index=email sourcetype="postfix:syslog" | rex "postfix/\w+\[\d+\]: (?[A-F0-9]{8,12}):" | rex "header From: (?.*?) from \w+\[" | stats values(sender) as sender by queue_id | where isnotnull(sender) | eval is_spoof=if(match(sender, "(?i)(micros0ft|spoofed|quick-invoices|onedrive|docusign|gmail\.com)"), 1, 0) | where is_spoof=1 | stats count

chart.title: Phishing Attack Vector & Lure Category Distribution

search.query: index=email sourcetype="postfix:syslog" | rex "postfix/\w+\[\d+\]: (?[A-F0-9]{8,12}):" | rex "header Subject: (?.*?) from \w+\[" | rex "header From: (?.*?) from \w+\[" | rex "(?:body|header)[^:\n]*:.*?(?https?://[^\s>\"\'\)]+)" | rex "(?<attachment_name>[\w\.\-]+\.(?:exe|xlsm|iso|pdf|vbs))" | stats values(sender) as sender, values(subject) as subject, values(attachment_name) as attachment_name, values(url) as url by queue_id | where isnotnull(sender) | eval category=case( isnotnull(attachment_name) AND match(attachment_name, "(?i)\.(exe|xlsm|iso|vbs)"), "Weaponized Attachment (T1566.001)", isnotnull(url) AND match(url, "(?i)(login|portal|auth|update|194\.)"), "Credential Harvester Link (T1566.002)", match(sender, "(?i)(ceo|cfo|executive)"), "Executive Impersonation / Whaling", match(subject, "(?i)(action required|mandatory policy)"), "Internal HR Mass Spray", true(), "Benign Corporate Traffic" ) | stats count by category
index=email sourcetype="postfix:syslog" | rex "header To: (?.*?) from \w+\[" | eval recipient=trim(recipient, "<> \"'") | where isnotnull(recipient) | stats count by recipient | sort - count
index=email sourcetype="postfix:syslog" | rex "from \w+\[(?\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)\]" | where isnotnull(src_ip) | stats count by src_ip

table.title: Phishing Incident Triage Queue (Live Postfix Syslog Telemetry)

search.query: index=email sourcetype="postfix:syslog" | rex "postfix/\w+\[\d+\]: (?[A-F0-9]{8,12}):" | rex "header Subject: (?.*?) from \w+\[" | rex "header From: (?.*?) from \w+\[" | rex "header To: (?.*?) from \w+\[" | rex "from \w+\[(?\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)\]" | rex "(?:body|header)[^:\n]*:.*?(?https?://[^\s>\"\'\)]+)" | rex "(?<attachment_name>[\w\.\-]+\.(?:exe|xlsm|iso|pdf|vbs))" | stats values(src_ip) as src_ip values(sender) as sender values(recipient) as recipient values(subject) as subject values(attachment_name) as attachment_name values(url) as url by queue_id | where isnotnull(sender) | eval sender=trim(sender, "<> \"'"), recipient=trim(recipient, "<> \"'") | eval Threat_Type=case( isnotnull(attachment_name) AND match(attachment_name, "(?i)\.(exe|xlsm|iso|vbs)"), "Weaponized Attachment (T1566.001)", isnotnull(url) AND match(url, "(?i)(login|portal|auth|update|194\.)"), "Credential Harvester (T1566.002)", match(sender, "(?i)(ceo|cfo|executive)"), "Executive Impersonation / Whaling", match(subject, "(?i)(action required|mandatory policy)"), "Internal HR Mass Spray", match(sender, "(?i)(spoofed|quick-invoices|docusign|payroll)"), "Domain Spoofing / Brand Masquerade", true(), "Benign Activity" ) | eval Risk_Score=case( match(Threat_Type, "Weaponized"), 98, match(Threat_Type, "Credential"), 94, match(Threat_Type, "Executive"), 92, match(Threat_Type, "Domain Spoofing"), 88, match(Threat_Type, "HR Mass Spray"), 82, true(), 0 ) | search Threat_Type!="Benign Activity" | table queue_id, src_ip, sender, recipient, subject, Threat_Type, attachment_name, url, Risk_Score | rename queue_id as "Queue ID", src_ip as "Sender IP", sender as "Sender Address", recipient as "Target Recipient", subject as "Email Subject", Threat_Type as "Threat Classification", attachment_name as "Attachment", url as "Extracted URL", Risk_Score as "Risk Score" | sort - "Risk Score"

index=email sourcetype="postfix:syslog" | rex "postfix/\w+\[\d+\]: (?[A-F0-9]{8,12}):" | rex "header Subject: (?.*?) from \w+\[" | rex "header From: (?.*?) from \w+\[" | rex "header To: (?.*?) from \w+\[" | rex "(?<attachment_name>[\w\.\-]+\.(?:exe|xlsm|iso|pdf|vbs))" | stats values(sender) as sender values(recipient) as recipient values(subject) as subject values(attachment_name) as attachment_name by queue_id | where isnotnull(attachment_name) AND match(attachment_name, "(?i)\.(exe|xlsm|iso|vbs)") | eval sender=trim(sender, "<> \"'"), recipient=trim(recipient, "<> \"'") | mvexpand attachment_name | eval threat_class=case( match(attachment_name, "(?i)\.(exe|pdf\.exe)"), "Executable Binary / Dual-Extension", match(attachment_name, "(?i)\.xlsm"), "Macro-Enabled Spreadsheet Dropper", match(attachment_name, "(?i)\.iso"), "Disk Image Container (MOTW Bypass)", true(), "Suspicious File" ) | table queue_id, sender, recipient, subject, attachment_name, threat_class | rename queue_id as "Queue ID", sender as "Sender", recipient as "Recipient", subject as "Subject", attachment_name as "Weaponized File", threat_class as "Threat Profile"

index=email sourcetype="postfix:syslog" | rex "postfix/\w+\[\d+\]: (?[A-F0-9]{8,12}):" | rex "header Subject: (?.*?) from \w+\[" | rex "header From: (?.*?) from \w+\[" | rex "header To: (?.*?) from \w+\[" | rex "(?:body|header)[^:\n]*:.*?(?<url>https?://[^\s>\"\'\)]+)" | stats values(sender) as sender values(recipient) as recipient values(subject) as subject values(url) as url by queue_id | where isnotnull(url) AND match(url, "(?i)(login|portal|auth|update|194\.|\.php)") | eval sender=trim(sender, "<> \"'"), recipient=trim(recipient, "<> \"'") | mvexpand url | eval url_type=case( match(url, "^http://\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}"), "Direct IP-Literal Web Host", match(url, "(?i)(login|signin|auth)"), "Credential Harvester Landing Page", match(url, "(?i)update"), "Fake Corporate Compliance Update", true(), "Suspicious Link" ) | table queue_id, sender, recipient, subject, url, url_type | rename queue_id as "Queue ID", sender as "Sender", recipient as "Recipient", subject as "Subject", url as "Extracted URL", url_type as "URL Classification"
